content.body:
Developed based on British observation of the successful Russian BT tank, the A13 was designed around the novel Christie suspension system, resulting in a fast tank with a good off-road performance. Coupled with its high-velocity 2pdr main gun, this made the A13 Cruiser series more than a match for any tank of its time.
Very thinly armored, the in-game model is actually the A13 Mk.II (or Cruiser Tank Mk.IVA) with supplemental armor plates on the turret and the nose. The tank was heavily used throughout the Blitzkrieg in Belgium and later in North Africa until replaced by its descendant the A15.
Control Variations: No driver periscope, but driver may zoom on open viewslit (numpad . or Del key). Closing view slit armor blocks vision completely. AP ammunition only and no range adjustment or gradation available through gunsight.
The A13 is an exemplary light tank with a gun capable of killing medium tanks. The green color and lethal main armament make it excellent from ambush, although the characteristically weak British optics somewhat negate the range advantage of the QF.2pdr gun. Drive it like an armored car pay close attention to your situation and don't stand and fight anything. Don't be afraid to stop and look around, as long as you're in cover; the green coloring will hide you from cursory examination.
Fear air attack, your roof/deck armor can be penetrated even by aircraft machineguns. If you are immobilized by enemy fire (as long as you're not burning with a big black cloud of smoke), don't despawn. The camouflage paint is so good that some incautious German tankers can be lured in closer to see if you've really despawned.
content.brief: TYPE: Light AFV ARMAMENT: 40mm Main Gun (QF.2pdr) 1 x .303 inch MG WEIGHT: 14225 kg SPEED (road): 48 km/h
